label: FP
reason: Both alerts are False Positives upon verification of the provided source code. Alert 1 (java/xss) targets lines 79-81, which output XML content (value.getTextContent()) and loop control, not the user-tainted 'bar' variable. Alert 2 (java/xml/xpath-injection) targets line 65, which is inside the catch block and safely encodes 'bar' using ESAPI.encodeForHTML. Although the code contains a real vulnerability at line 47 (expression construction), neither alert covers that location.

evidence.note: XSS sink location per Alert 1; code outputs XML node text content, not user input 'bar'.
XPath injection sink location per Alert 2; code safely encodes 'bar' in error message.
